Plants of the World Online account: Sanchezia oblonga Ruiz & Pav..

The native range of this species is SE. Colombia to NW. Bolivia and N. Brazil. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome. It is has environmental uses and as a medicine.
